sources.notes: 2026-07-23: craigslist HTML search became a JS shell (no result links); discovery now uses the public sapi.craigslist.org JSON search endpoint (same data the shell loads) and still fetches detail pages as HTML. Query terms switched from neighborhood text queries to borough-scoped searches (mnh/brk/que/brx/stn + /apa), city-wide as of 2026-07-23: posters pick neighborhoods from a dropdown, not ad text, so text queries matched only ~60 spam-heavy items while borough feeds carry the real inventory. Neighborhood matching happens downstream from geo/hood data. Rate limits and cache reuse unchanged.

2026-07-23: StreetEasy moved search results into the Next.js React Flight stream (edges are $-refs to numbered chunks); adapter parses the chunk map now. Not bot-walled -- plain urllib still gets full SSR pages. Yield warning: sub-$2500 studio/1BR inventory in these neighborhoods is nearly zero right now (observed totalCount 0 for most areas, East Village at $6000 cap = 189), so low daily counts are market reality, not extraction failure.

2026-07-23: rebuilt after the June adapter was lost with ~/Projects. openigloo is a building-review platform (tenants rate landlords) — aligned with the private-landlord mission. Server-rendered unit cards carry address/price/beds/baths/neighborhood/photos, so discovery is one request per borough with no detail fetches. Filter syntax: /listings/borough:<b>|price:-<max>. VERIFIED 2026-07-23: the site's nbr:<slug> filter is NOT reliable for scoping — nbr:alphabet-city returns Washington Heights/Inwood/East Harlem, and most target-neighborhood slugs return 0 even though the slug vocabulary is valid. So query borough-wide and let VERA's own neighborhood filter scope it; do not re-attempt nbr: scoping. Records outside the target neighborhoods correctly skip at the hard-filter stage.

Atom feed only (JSON API 403s unauthenticated). Offer leads, not listings: filtered to posts with a price and unit keywords, seekers excluded. Expected to land in manual review; thread link is the contact surface.
